This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin, large [[ear]]s, and distinct glossy blue suits with masks that covered most of their faces and connected to devices on their backs via a pair of tubes. They also appeared to possess tentacle-like [[Limb|arms]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 BBY]], a pair of members of this species could be found in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], present during the arrest of [[Ghorman]] [[senator]], [[Dasi Oran]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The species was designed by [[Wikipedia:Artist|artist]] [[Tom Blake]].<ref name="Blake Concept">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tomblakedesign.com/design/andor2|text=STAR WARS ANDOR SEASON 2|work=[[Tom Blake]]'s [https://www.tomblakedesign.com official website]|archivedate=20250623003358}}</ref>
